The Bags App and Site are the interfaces that allow you to use and interact with the Services. Some of these services may not be available to you depending on your jurisdiction or for other reasons.

The Services include a suite of tools that enable users to send messages to other users and verify authentic engagement within the Services. The Services also includes information related to third party products and services ("Content"), in particular but not limited to cryptographic tokens, digital currencies, cryptocurrencies, and virtual currencies (collectively, "Digital Assets").

3.2 Unhosted Wallet Application

Bags makes available to users an unhosted wallet application ("Non-Custodial Wallet"). The Non-Custodial Wallet enables users to (a) store locally on their own devices, Digital Assets; (b) link to decentralized applications; (c) from the Bags App or Site user interface, transact Digital Assets; (d) view addresses and information that are part of blockchain networks and broadcast transactions. We will not create any hosted wallet for you or otherwise custody Digital Assets on your behalf, and it is your responsibility to maintain the security of your Non-Custodial Wallet.

3.3 Rewards Program

Bags may offer, from time to time, an incentive program via the Bags App, the Site, and such other channels as Bags may make available from time to time (collectively, the "Rewards Program"). The Rewards Program may allow users who undertake certain activities within the Services to get rewarded with virtual incentives.

3.4 Referral Program

Bags may, from time to time, allow you to earn Bags Points in connection with taking actions to promote the Services, including by referring a friend to the Service ("Referral Program"). To be eligible to earn points through the Referral Program: (a) you must refer a new user to the Services by providing your personalized link; (b) the new user must use your link to create a user account; and (c) the new user must complete specified activities on the Bags App or Site.

If you are an individual, you represent and warrant that you are at least 18 years old, capable of forming a binding contract with Bags in your respective jurisdiction, and not a Restricted Party as defined in Subsection 4.2 below.

4.2 Restricted Parties

In connection with the Services, you represent and warrant that you will comply with all applicable laws including but not limited to export restrictions, end-user restrictions, antiterrorism laws, anti-money laundering laws, and economic sanctions. 4.3 Registration

By using the Services, you acknowledge and agree that we are not responsible for operation of the underlying protocols and that we make no guarantee of their functionality, security, or availability.

Legal Terms and Conditions for Using Bonk.fun

Last Updated: 2025-09-30

These Terms of Use ("Terms") constitute a legally binding agreement between you ("you" or "your") and the operators of Bonk.fun ("Bonk", "we", "us", or "our"). These Terms govern your access to and use of Bonk.fun and any associated features, services, or tools (collectively, the "Services").

By accessing or using the Services, you agree to be bound by these Terms. If you do not agree to these Terms, you must not access or use the Services.

1
About Bonk.fun

Bonk.fun is a non-custodial front-end interface that allows users to interact with on-chain smart contracts deployed on the Solana blockchain, including contracts developed and maintained by the Raydium protocol ("Raydium"). We do not control or operate the underlying blockchain or smart contracts. Your use of the Services is at your own risk.

We do not provide brokerage, custody, investment, legal, or tax advice. All interactions with Bonk.fun are self-directed and at your discretion.

Bonk.fun is operated under the laws of the British Virgin Islands. For specific information about the legal entity behind Bonk.fun, please contact us at the email listed in Section 14.

2
Eligibility

You must be at least 18 years old and have the legal capacity to enter into these Terms. You may not use the Services if you are located in, incorporated in, or a resident of any jurisdiction subject to sanctions or restrictions, or where your use would violate applicable law.

3
Wallet Connection

To use Bonk.fun, you must connect a third-party, non-custodial digital wallet ("Wallet"). We do not control your Wallet, and we cannot access, recover, or reverse transactions from your Wallet.

4
No Affiliation with Raydium

Bonk.fun operates independently and is not affiliated with, sponsored by, or endorsed by the Raydium protocol or its developers. While we use smart contracts maintained by Raydium, we do not represent them, and your use of Bonk.fun does not imply any relationship with Raydium.

5
Risks

Using Bonk.fun and interacting with digital assets carries inherent risks, including but not limited to:

Loss of digital assets due to user error, smart contract bugs, or malicious activity
High volatility in asset value
Regulatory uncertainty
Permanent loss due to failed transactions

You acknowledge and accept these risks. You are solely responsible for conducting your own due diligence and understanding the implications of your actions.

6

Bonk.fun may charge fees for certain transactions, which will be transparently displayed before confirmation. Additional network (blockchain) fees may apply. We reserve the right to modify our fee structure at any time.

7
Prohibited Conduct

You agree not to:

Use the Services for unlawful purposes
Violate applicable laws or regulations
Attempt to exploit, reverse-engineer, or harm the interface or underlying smart contracts
Engage in market manipulation, fraud, or abusive behavior
Use Bonk.fun in a jurisdiction where it is prohibited
8
Content Moderation Standards

The following moderation standards apply solely to content submitted to or displayed on the BONK.fun mobile application (the "App"). For avoidance of doubt, these standards do not apply to the BONK.fun website (the "Website"), which is a separate Service and is not subject to the content moderation requirements described below.

1. Content Quality and Accuracy

All content submitted through the App must be factually correct, reasonably well-researched, and verifiable. Submissions must be free from spelling, grammatical, or formatting errors. Where applicable, appropriate sources must be cited or otherwise reasonably identifiable.

2. Content Standards and Safety

Content containing hate speech, discriminatory language, slurs, harassment, explicit sexual material, or material that promotes violence, abuse, or unlawful conduct is strictly prohibited. Content designed to mislead, defraud, or cause harm will not be approved.

3. Legal and Compliance Review

All content submitted through the App must comply with applicable laws, regulations, and industry standards, including without limitation copyright, trademark, and accessibility requirements. Required disclaimers must be included where necessary. Users represent and warrant that they have secured all rights, licenses, or permissions necessary for the content they submit.

4. Eligibility of Digital Assets

Any coin, token, or digital asset referenced or submitted for inclusion on the App must demonstrate organic activity and meet minimum requirements, including without limitation:

Documented organic trading volume;
A verifiable number of unique holders; and
A market capitalization threshold determined at BONK.fun's sole discretion.

BONK.fun reserves the right to deny or remove any asset that does not satisfy these requirements.

5. Moderation Workflow

Review Method: All content is manually reviewed by BONK.fun staff prior to publication on the App. Automated filters and AI-based moderation tools are not used.

Decision Criteria: If a submission violates any of the standards set forth in Sections 1–4, it will be rejected.

Escalation: Because all reviews are manual and performed prior to publication, escalation from automated filters does not apply.

6. Timing of Moderation

Pre-Publication Review: Every submission is reviewed and either approved or rejected before being made public on the App.

Post-Publication Monitoring: BONK.fun does not actively monitor content after publication, as token metadata is immutable once approved and recorded.

7. User Reporting and Escalation

Reporting Mechanism: Users may report inappropriate or prohibited content by contacting the designated moderator at @Skg122 on Telegram.

Process: Upon receipt of a report, BONK.fun will review the flagged content in accordance with these standards.

Resolution: Reports will be evaluated by human reviewers, and decisions will be made at BONK.fun's sole discretion. BONK.fun does not guarantee any specific turnaround time for the resolution of user reports but will make commercially reasonable efforts to address them promptly.

8. Enforcement

BONK.fun may, in its sole discretion, reject, restrict, or remove content that violates these standards. Violations may result in suspension or termination of access to the App.

9
Intellectual Property

Bonk.fun and its original content (excluding open-source components) are owned by or licensed to us. You may not copy, modify, or reuse our branding, interface, or materials without our prior written consent.

10
Disclaimer

The Services are provided "as is" and "as available" without warranties of any kind. We disclaim all implied warranties including merchantability, fitness for a particular purpose, and non-infringement.

11
Limitation of Liability

To the maximum extent permitted by law, we shall not be liable for any indirect, incidental, consequential, or punitive damages arising from or related to your use of the Services.

12
Indemnification

You agree to indemnify and hold harmless Bonk, its operators, developers, affiliates, and service providers from any claims, damages, losses, or expenses arising from your use of the Services.

13
Termination

We may terminate or suspend your access to the Services at any time, with or without notice, for any reason. These Terms survive termination.

14
Governing Law & Dispute Resolution

These Terms shall be governed by the laws of the British Virgin Islands. You agree to resolve any disputes through binding arbitration.

15
Contact

For questions or support, please contact: support@bonk.fun

Official updates will be posted on X (@bonkfun)

We may update these Terms at any time. If we do, the "Last Updated" date at the top will be changed. Continued use of the Services after such updates constitutes acceptance.
